description: Manages information about individuals or points of contact, including their personal, professional, and communication details, often associated with partner organizations or interactions.

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new contact with comprehensive personal and professional details.

req.description: Contact creation request with required fields

example_uses: Create a contact named John Doe with email john@unicef.org
Add a new program manager contact for partner 123
Register Dr. Jane Smith as the technical lead
Create contact with full address information
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to add, create, register, or set up a new contact.

endpoints.name: ListAllContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves all contacts with basic pagination and ordering (no search criteria).

ascending.description: Sort direction - true for ascending, false for descending (default: true)

example_uses: List all contacts in the system
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to see ALL contacts without any search criteria or when asking for a general contact list.

endpoints.name: SearchContacts
endpoints.description: Performs simple text search across multiple contact fields (name, email, title, etc.). Use the 'searchText' parameter for a general keyword search. For more specific or complex searches, use the 'AdvancedSearchContacts' endpoint.

request.description: Pagination request containing only pagination and sorting parameters

searchText.description: Text to search across contact name, email, title, and other basic fields

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for simple name, email, title, or basic field searches. NOT for partner relationship searches.

endpoints.name: AdvancedSearchContacts
endpoints.description: Performs advanced search with structured criteria including relationships with partners, departments, and complex filters. Use the 'searchCriteria' parameter, which expects a JSON array of objects. Each object should have 'field', 'operator', and 'value'. Available fields include direct fields like 'firstName', 'email', 'department', and nested fields like 'partner.name', 'partner.status'. Available operators are 'like', 'is', 'not', 'contains', 'startsWith', 'endsWith', 'between', 'greaterThan', 'lessThan', 'greaterThanOrEqual', 'lessThanOrEqual', 'on', 'not on', 'this week', 'this month', 'this year'. For example, to find contacts from UNICEF partners, use: `[{"field": "partner.name", "operator": "like", "value": "UNICEF"}]`.

request.description: Pagination request containing only pagination and sorting parameters

searchCriteria.description: JSON array of search criteria objects with field, operator, value, and logicalOperator

searchText.description: Optional additional text search to combine with criteria

example_uses: Find contacts from UNICEF partner organization
Show contacts in Finance department created this month
Get contacts working at Asian Infrastructure partners
Find contacts where partner status is Active
Search for contacts by department and creation date
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for searches involving partner relationships, departments, dates, status, or any complex multi-field criteria.

endpoints.name: Get
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific contact by ID with complete details including partner information and all contact methods.
example_uses: Show me details for contact ID 123
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific contact details by ID or when you need complete contact information.

endpoints.name: Update
endpoints.description: Updates an existing contact's information including personal details, contact methods, and professional information.

req.description: Contact update request containing modified fields

example_uses: Change contact 456's title to Senior Manager
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to update, modify, edit, or change contact information.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.description: Soft deletes a contact from the system (marks as deleted rather than permanent removal).
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to delete, remove, or eliminate a contact.

endpoints.name: PartnerContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves all contacts associated with a specific partner organization with access control.

partnerId.description: Partner organization ID to get contacts for

example_uses: Show all contacts for partner organization 123
Get contact list for UNICEF partner
Find all people working at partner ID 456
List contacts belonging to a specific organization
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to see contacts for a specific partner, organization, or wants to view who works at a particular partner.

endpoints.name: PermissionsGet
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current user's permissions for a specific contact (read, update, delete).

id.description: Contact ID to check permissions for

example_uses: What can I do with contact 456?
Get access rights for this contact
Can I update this contact's information?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to check user permissions before performing operations or showing UI elements for contact management.

endpoints.name: UploadProfilePicture
endpoints.description: Uploads and associates a profile picture with a contact (max 1MB, JPEG/PNG/WEBP only).

id.description: Contact ID to upload profile picture for

example_uses: Upload a profile picture for contact 123
Add photo to contact John Doe
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to add or update a contact's profile picture or photo.

endpoints.name: ScanContactData
endpoints.description: Scans and processes uploaded files for contact data extraction using AI-powered analysis.

req.description: File scan request containing the file to be processed

example_uses: Scan business cards for contact information
Process contact information from uploaded files
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to upload and scan documents for contact data extraction using AI.

endpoints.name: AnalyseContactData
endpoints.description: Analyzes uploaded files and extracts structured contact data using AI-powered data analysis.

request.description: Analysis request containing file and analysis parameters

example_uses: Analyze contact directories for structured data extraction
Extract contact information from uploaded forms
Convert contact files into structured database entries
Analyze business card data for key information
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to analyze files and extract structured contact data for database import.

endpoints.name: BulkUploadContacts
endpoints.description: Bulk uploads multiple contact records using AI-assisted data processing and validation.

req.description: Bulk upload request containing contact data

example_uses: Import multiple contacts from CSV file
Mass upload contact data with AI validation
Bulk import contact records with duplicate detection
Upload large contact dataset with automated processing
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to upload multiple contact records at once with AI-assisted processing.
